notes.title: Catastronauts can now be played online with Remote Play Together!
notes.notes:
Steam's new Remote Play Together feature had its official launch last week, and it's the perfect way to enjoy Catastronauts with friends who are further afield!

The feature allows friends to play local multiplayer games online together. Only the host will need to have the game in their Steam Library, and there's no need to install or set up additional software - you just need the game and the Steam client and you're good to go!

To use Remote Play Together with Catastronauts, just launch the game as normal. Then open the Steam Overlay with SHIFT+TAB, right click on a friend in the friends list, and select Remote Play Together. Make sure you both have your controllers plugged in ready to go before starting!

notes.title: Co-op space disaster party game Catastronauts is out now
notes.notes:
Catastronauts‘s mash-up of FTL’s stressful space combat and Overcooked’s messy co-op is an inspired hybrid and a fit logical enough to satisfy even a Vulcan. Released today and made by Inertia Game Studios, it’s a co-op party game for one to four people, ideally huddled around a TV and free to shout at each other. As a crew of expendable and all-too-fragile redshirts (and other colours, but whatever), you’ve got to keep your ship functioning as it braves stellar dangers, fights hostile aliens and generally lands you in all kinds of trouble.
